Consider the following statements:

Statement I: D will play for the team which has picked up the most number of players in the auction.

Statement II: V and Z were picked up by KKR in the auction.

Statement III: P and X will be teammates in the upcoming league.

Which of the above statements is/are not true?
questions.explanation:
Given: Nine players were picked up by three different teams in an auction.

It is also given that the number of players picked up by each team is different in number and not less than two.

This implies that the grouping will be in the pattern of 2 – 3 – 4. This means one team has picked two, one has picked three and the other has picked up four players in the auction.

Now from the given conditions, we get the following possibilities:

From the above final table, we check the correctness of the given statements as follows:

Statement I: D will play for the team which has picked up the most number of players in the auction. This statement is true. D will represent CSK who picked up the highest number of players in the auction. 

Statement II: V and Z were picked up by KKR in the auction. This statement is false. They were picked up by LSG. 

Statement III: P and X will be teammates in the upcoming league. This statement is false. Both of them were picked up by different teams in the auction. 

Hence, both the statements II and III are not true.
